path_trace: build_semantic_projection accepts the forged generation_id because generation identity is an opaque non-empty wrapper field
_validate_projection rebuilds the projection and therefore accepts the self-consistent forged wrapper

_validate_projection_generation_binding checks generation_id == hash(caller supplied series_id, projection_sha256, source_first_valid_time) but receives no P1EmpiricalDistinctionSeries record and proves no first_generation_id/root binding
stage_correspondence therefore cannot distinguish a canonical admitted generation from an orphan self-consistent generation record
owner-plane evidence and DMRP evidence can be generated against the forged generation_id, allowing the downstream exact correspondence path to reach AUTO_ADMITTED when all planes are supplied

discrepancies.expected: Every generation used to establish or stage P1CDI correspondence must be a canonical P1EmpiricalDistinctionGeneration rooted in exactly one valid P1EmpiricalDistinctionSeries whose first_generation_id and deterministic series identity are provable. A self-consistent generation hash using an arbitrary caller-supplied series_id is insufficient.
discrepancies.actual: _validate_projection_generation_binding receives only projection and generation. It recomputes generation_id from generation.series_id, projection_sha256 and source_first_valid_time but never receives or verifies the corresponding Series record, first_generation_id, or deterministic root. stage_correspondence therefore accepts the generation wrapper as canonical once the caller recomputes its self-consistent hash, even when the series_id is an orphan unrelated to the fixture's lawful series identity.
discrepancies.design_basis: P1EmpiricalDistinctionSeries is the stable continuing Path-1 research lineage; P1EmpiricalDistinctionGeneration is one immutable meaning within that lineage; WP4/G4 independently reproduces Series/Generation identity and operates over canonical records.
discrepancies.minimal_repair: Require an exact series/root binding at the correspondence boundary (for example explicit left/right series records or a validated identity bundle) and reuse the existing deterministic series-root/first-generation checks before any plane result. Preserve generation-only validation as a subordinate check, not the complete canonical-admission proof.

gate_decision_rationale: Remediation-3 correctly closes all three fresh-review-2 defects and retains exact deterministic oracle behavior. Fresh review 3 nevertheless found one independent fail-closed gap at the canonical Series/Generation boundary: correspondence proves projection-to-generation self-consistency but not that the generation belongs to a lawful canonical Series root. Because Series/Generation identity is itself a G4-ALG acceptance surface, the gate cannot PASS while an orphan self-consistent generation can reach correspondence staging.
rollback_remediation_route: Preserve all three prior immutable G4 BLOCK packets and remediations 1/2/3. Materialise this BLOCK without invoking any PASS route. Then execute one bounded P1CDII-WP4-REMEDIATION-4 that adds exact canonical series/root proof before correspondence staging, with focused adversarial fixtures for forged orphan series IDs, missing series records, mismatched first-generation roots, lawful successor generations and valid exact rediscovery. The remediation author may issue PASS_REMEDIATION only and may not issue G4-ALG PASS. Then commission a fresh conflict-free P1CDII-G4-ALG review-4.
